Risk title: Investment in fleet capacity that does not match future demand
Value effects: Organic EBITDA; Investment EBITDA; Multiple; Cash/NIBD
Cause: Uncertain forecasts of salmon production, customer demand and competitor capacity
Risk event: Trident commits capital to vessel segments or geographies with insufficient demand
Consequences: Low utilization, reduced returns and constrained financial flexibility

Risk title: Strategic initiatives fail to translate into accountable execution
Cause: Insufficient ownership, capacity, milestones or cross-functional alignment
Risk event: Material strategic initiatives are delayed or incompletely implemented
Consequences: Growth, integration and value-creation targets are not achieved

Risk title: SFaaS expansion creates exposures outside established capabilities
Cause: Expansion from vessel services into aquaculture infrastructure
Risk event: The operating model, technology or commercial structure performs below plan
Consequences: Capital loss, operational liabilities and reputational harm
Affected units: Finance; Commercial; Technical & HSEQ; Vessel Operations

Risk title: Strategic decisions rely on incomplete or unreliable information
Value effects: Organic EBITDA; Investment EBITDA; Multiple; Cash conversion; Cash/NIBD
Cause: Group data and external intelligence are fragmented or inconsistent
Risk event: Management bases decisions on assumptions that are not sufficiently tested
Consequences: Misallocation of capital and delayed corrective decisions

Risk title: Acquisitions fail to deliver expected synergies
Value effects: Investment EBITDA; Multiple; Cash conversion; Cash/NIBD
Cause: Due diligence, integration planning or ownership of synergies is insufficient
Risk event: An acquired business is not integrated effectively
Consequences: Synergies are delayed, costs increase and group governance remains fragmented
